import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction Amount Distribution by Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
transaction_types = data.groupby('transaction_type')['amount'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", len(transaction_types))
ax1.bar(transaction_types.index, transaction_types.values, color=colors, edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Amount ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Total Transaction Amount by Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction Count by Hour of Day
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
hourly_counts = data.groupby('hour_of_day').size()
ax2.plot(hourly_counts.index, hourly_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.fill_between(hourly_counts.index, hourly_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2E86AB')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Transaction Volume by Hour', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax2.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 2))

# 3. Transaction Amount vs Hour (Scatter)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
type_colors = {'payment': '#E63946', 'transfer': '#2A9D8F', 'refund': '#F4A261'}
for trans_type in data['transaction_type'].unique():
    subset = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    ax3.scatter(subset['hour_of_day'], subset['amount'], 
               label=trans_type.capitalize(), 
               s=150, alpha=0.7, 
               color=type_colors.get(trans_type, '#264653'),
               edgecolors='black', linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Transaction Amount ($)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Time of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.legend(title='Type', fontsize=9)
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 4. Fraud Status Overview (Pie Chart)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
fraud_counts = data['is_fraud'].value_counts()
fraud_labels = ['Legitimate', 'Fraud'] if len(fraud_counts) > 1 else ['Legitimate']
fraud_colors = ['#06D6A0', '#EF476F']
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax4.pie(fraud_counts.values, 
                                     labels=[f'{label}\n({count})' for label, count in zip(fraud_labels, fraud_counts.values)],
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                     colors=fraud_colors[:len(fraud_counts)],
                                     startangle=90,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 10, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax4.set_title('Fraud vs Legitimate Transactions', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
